name: Shining Road 2: Kuroki Ryuu no Miko
summary: A sequel to Shining Road: To the Force that continues its party-based dungeon exploration and formation battles. New enemies, traps, stronger bosses and dungeons with party-size restrictions expand the challenges. Players can carry experience and acquired items over from the preceding game.
